title: I've run the businesses. Now I'm building the tools I wish I'd had.
caption:
I've run the businesses. Now I'm building the tools I wish I'd had.

I'm Phil. My work has taken me through rental cars, hosting, teaching and plenty of figuring things out the hard way. These days, I'm using AI to build around the problems I've seen firsthand.

Build With Phil is where I share the process: what I made, how it works, what broke and what I'd do differently.

You'll see practical AI demos, business lessons, and some of the life happening in between.

If you run a business and aren't sure where AI could help, start with my free AI Profit Finder. It's a guided exercise to identify tasks worth exploring.

You'll also find blueprints if you want to build it yourself and custom-build options if you'd like my help.

Start here: https://v2.stan.store/buildwithphil?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=build_with_phil&utm_content=pinned_welcome
